e.title: Tree-Like PIN (Richman/Scognamiglio/Wüthrich)
e.summary: 树状成对交互网络（PIN）论文代码：表格数据特征交互建模，保险定价用
e.body:
Tree-Like-PIN 是论文《Tree-Like Pairwise Interaction Network (PIN)》（Richman, Scognamiglio, Wüthrich）的代码与数据：建模表格数据的特征交互——成对交互网络（PIN）的树状结构变体，用于保险定价等预测建模。与 [[aitools4actuaries]]（同组作者的课程）、[[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-nam]]（神经加性模型）同属精算深度学习方法谱。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]。

## 同类工具
[[two-factor-vasicek-python]]、[[v-star-actuarial-engine]]、[[va-heatmap-simulation-machine]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: Paper code of the Tree-Like Pairwise Interaction Network (PIN): modelling feature interactions in tabular data for insurance pricing
e.summary_hk: 樹狀成對交互網絡（PIN）論文代碼：表格數據特徵交互建模，保險定價用
e.body_en:
Tree-Like-PIN is the code and data of the paper 'Tree-Like Pairwise Interaction Network (PIN)' (Richman, Scognamiglio, Wüthrich): modelling feature interactions in tabular data — a tree-like variant of pairwise interaction networks for predictive modelling such as insurance pricing. Joins the actuarial deep-learning method spectrum with [[aitools4actuaries]] (course by the same group), [[machine-learning-pricing]] and [[actuarial-nam]] (neural additive models). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]].
